problems.question: What does Lenz’s law describe?
options: The speed of the induced electrons
The temperature change in the coil
problems.hint: Lenz’s law is about how the induced current responds to changes in magnetic flux.
problems.detailed: Lenz’s law states that the direction of an induced current in a circuit is such that it opposes the change in magnetic flux that caused it. This means the induced current creates a magnetic field that opposes the original change in magnetic flux. problems.question: If the magnetic flux through a loop is increasing, the induced current will create a magnetic field that…
problems.detailed: When magnetic flux increases through a loop, Lenz’s law states that the induced current will produce a magnetic field that opposes that increase in flux, resisting the change.  [oai_citation:2‡GeeksforGeeks](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/physics/lenzs-law/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
problems.author: Keyner Avendano

problems.question: According to Lenz’s law, if a bar magnet is moved toward a coil, the induced current will flow in such a way that it…
options: has no effect on the magnet
problems.hint: Lenz’s law causes an opposition to motion.
problems.detailed: When a magnet is pushed toward a coil, the induced current’s magnetic field opposes that motion. The coil becomes a magnet that repels the approaching magnet, opposing the change in magnetic flux.
